# `adt checkin`

Push a local abapGit/gCTS-formatted directory into SAP (inverse of checkout)

```bash
adt checkin [options] <directory>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument      | Description                                  | Default |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<directory>` | Source directory containing serialised files |         |

**Options**

| Option                              | Description                                                     | Default   |
| ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `--format <format>`                 | Format plugin id (default 'abapgit'; try 'gcts' for AFF layout) | `abapgit` |
| `-p, --package <package>`           | Target root SAP package for the checkin                         |           |
| `-t, --transport <transport>`       | Transport request to use for lock/save operations               |           |
| `--types <types>`                   | Filter by object types (comma-separated, e.g. CLAS,INTF)        |           |
| `--dry-run`                         | Validate & plan only — no writes to SAP                         | `false`   |
| `--no-activate`                     | Skip activation after save (objects remain inactive)            |           |
| `--unlock`                          | Release objects only when this CLI persisted their lock handles | `false`   |
| `--abap-language-version <version>` | ABAP language version for new objects (e.g. '5' for Cloud)      |           |
| `--json`                            | Emit the CheckinResult as JSON (machine-readable)               | `false`   |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
